source_snapshot.procedure: Boot BMC into U-Boot and run dramtest 0 for over 12 hours.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; manual BMC U-Boot DRAM cold/low-rail test.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY; requires vendor semantics, console evidence, low-rail/dew-point controls and service recovery.

old_problem: Vendor-specific dramtest 0 range/return semantics were absent, but can be an explicit authorization gate without leaving review unresolved.
disposition_reason: ED-03 forbids guessing OEM semantics yet permits a vendor-gated BMC procedure. Execution is prohibited until exact U-Boot help/spec, safe range and recovery are approved; ED-14 preserves over 12 hours.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row58 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3092 and actual next row59/history3093 were read.
The literal command is retained but its memory range, destructiveness, loop/progress and return behavior are never generalized across platforms.
Continuous console plus independent observation distinguishes progress, UART loss and BMC hang under low rail.
Production firmware/network/sensor recovery and dry warm-up are mandatory; no action ran.

test_case.test_name: BMC U-Boot dramtest 0 for over 12 hours at 0C/-5% rails
test_case.purpose: Verify BMC-local DRAM under the approved vendor implementation at cold/low-rail margin and prove full return to production services.
required_package: Vendor authority for dramtest 0 range/destructive/loop semantics
test_case.test_command: Only after BMC-owner authorization, qualified staff run the exact documented `dramtest 0` for more than 12 hours on the approved U-Boot build under dry 0C/-5% conditions, capture the console continuously, then use the approved exit/reset and verify all BMC services after dry restoration.
test_case.expected_result: The authorized range shows documented progress without memory error/hang and firmware boot, management network, Redfish/IPMI, sensors and logs recover normally.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the exact approved implementation/range, uninterrupted >12-hour evidence and service recovery; guessed semantics or silent console cannot pass.
safety_gate: Vendor/BMC-owner authorization and preserved boot state
Independent recovery and calibrated low-rail ramp
Abort on memory error, console loss, moisture, electrical or thermal limit
test_case.recovery: Use only the approved exit/reset path, preserve transcript, restore nominal rails, warm/dry, restore boot state and quarantine on failed service recovery; no automatic retry.

source_conflict.reason: Sources align; vendor semantics are a pre-execution gate.

blocked.reason: Review defines a safe vendor-gated manual contract.
